punchline: Nir Eyal cut the internet out of his writing and caught himself flipping through random books on the shelf instead.
thirty_sec: Nir Eyal missed his daughter's answer to 'what superpower would you want?' because he was on his phone. So he went extreme: flip phone, paper newspaper, a word processor with no internet. The papers piled up unread and he started leafing through books on the shelf. His conclusion: distraction starts from within. Now he notes the feeling and waits ten minutes before giving in.
key_contrast: Blame the device, find the feeling
